verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is an offline USB/NFC hardware security key that stores passkeys on the device. It is not a data-collecting service or an AI product, so an opt-out from AI model training does not apply to this kind of product. The local-storage claim ('stays on your key. Not their cloud') concerns credential locality, not AI training, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
